title: Multiplex immunofluorescence-guided laser capture microdissection for spatial transcriptomics of metastatic melanoma tissues
protocol: Prepare fresh RLT buffer.
For each tissue, cut an 8 μm cryosection.
Collect the section with a RNAse free 200 μL pipet tip.
Maintain the tip at 23°C.
As the tip comes into contact with the tissue it will melt and aggregate on the tip.
Immediately immerse the tip into 350 μl of RLT buffer and homogenize.
Dissolve all tissue thoroughly.
Keep samples on ice if processing multiple samples simultaneously.
Purify RNA using the Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Assess RNA integrity using the Agilent Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity RNA 6000 Pico kit following the manufacturer’s instructions.
Select samples with a RNA Integrity Number (RIN) greater than 8.
Stain tissue sections for histological assessment.
Immerse section in 70% ethanol for 1 minute.
Wash section in distilled water (DI water) for 1 minute.
Immersion in hematoxylin solution for 2 minutes.
Rinse section with DI water for 1 minute.
Expose to blueing agent for 1 minute.
Soak in 70% ethanol for 1 minute.
Submerge in 95% ethanol for 1 minute.
Stain with eosin solution for 4 minutes.
Wash briefly in 70% ethanol for 1 minute.
Immerse section in 95% ethanol again for 1 minute.
Dry section in 100% ethanol for 1 minute.
Clear section using xylene for 5 minutes.
Air dry the section for 15 minutes.
Mount slides with cytoseal mounting medium.
Acquire whole section scans at 20x magnification using the tile image tool on the Arcturus system.
Select samples without necrotic areas.
Cut an 8 μm cryo-section for each tissue.
Fix sections in cold acetone for 5 minutes.
Air dry the fixed sections for 20 minutes.
Back circle samples with sharpie to delineate tissue on slide and avoid damage during staining procedures.
Circle sample with pap pen.
Wash sections twice with PBS for 5 minutes each.
Incubate sections with Fc Blocker for 40 minutes.
Rinse sections with PBS.
Incubate sections with Background Buster for 30 minutes.
Rinse sections with PBS.
Incubate sections with anti-Melanoma Ag AF488, anti-CD14 AF647 and anti-CD3 AF594 in PBS containing 5% BSA and 0.1% Saponin for 1 hour.
Wash sections twice with PBS containing 0.1% Saponin for 5 minutes each.
Counterstain sections with DAPI at 1 μg/mL in PBS for 2 minutes.
Rinse sections with PBS.
Mount sections in Fluoromount-G.
Acquire whole section scans on Leica SP8 confocal microscope at 20× magnification.
Stitch and max project each scan in LAS X.
Evaluate each sample for the presence, abundance, and localization of each cell type to be harvested by LCM.
Screen samples for high RNA quality and absence of necrotic areas.
Select samples with sufficient numbers of specific cell types to be harvested.
Remove samples that are early melanoma metastasis with minimal invasion by cancer cells.
Use a "GPS" slide consisting of a whole section scan after immunofluorescence staining.
Display the GPS slide next to the LCM monitor for guidance during harvest.
Power on the Arcturus XT system.
Open the Arcuturs software.
Power on the Lumencor SPECTRA system.
Open the LLE 7ch controller Lumencor software.
Prepare the stage for harvest.
In Arcturus, select “present stage”.
Install the tray on LCM Cap sure.
Indicate the number of caps present in the tray in the software.
Perform IF staining for LCM.
Place the sample in the cryostat.
Let the sample reach chamber temperature for 10 minutes.
Cut a 5 μm section.
Transfer immediately onto a clean frosted supercharged glass slide.
Fix for 2 minutes in cold acetone.
Air dry for 2 minutes.
Back-circle tissue with sharpie.
Place on a cold block.
Perform IF staining.
Wash for 2 minutes with PBS + Superase in.
Incubate for 10 minutes with antibody mix + Superase in.
Wash twice for 2 minutes each with PBS + Superase in.
Counterstain for 1 minute with PBS + DAPI + Superase in.
Dehydrate the sample.
Immerse for 30 seconds in 75% ethanol.
Immerse for 30 seconds in 95% ethanol.
Immerse for 1 minute in 100% ethanol.
Immerse for 5 minutes in xylene.
Air dry for 5 minutes.
Proceed to LCM harvest.
Install the slide on the stage.
Select the corresponding slide slot in the software.
Acquire a slide overview.
Center on the area of tissue where to perform the harvest based on GPS slide.
Place Cap on live image location.
Switch to 40× objective.
Locate an empty zone and center on it.
Open select option dialogue.
Test IR laser.
Using right click on main screen, locate IR laser at the exact location where test IR shot appeared.
Adjust laser power/duration to generate adequate capture spot (meaning the polymer on cap made contact with glass).
Using ruler tool, determine capture spot’s diameter.
Adjust laser power to obtain a capture spot 8 μm in diameter.
Click “OK”.
Switch to fluorescence mode.
In Lumencor software, turn violet, cyan, and green lasers on.
Adjust power for each laser line in Lumencor.
Adjust exposure time in Arcturus so that all markers are visible and their signals balanced.
Click on IR capture spots.
Select intra-tumoral CD14+ cells to be harvested in the field of view.
Capture image.
Move to a different area.
Select additional intra-tumoral CD14+ cells to be harvest.
Capture image.
Repeat until around 50 cells are selected.
Exit fluorescence mode.
Click on IR capture only.
Send cap to QC station.
Present stage.
Carefully pick up cap and firmly place on Gene Amp tube containing lysis buffer.
Invert tube so that all lysis buffer rests on cap’s surface.
Incubate 30 min at 42°C.
Select Capture group “B”.
Repeat steps iv to xxxi to harvest stromal CD14+ cells.
Select Capture group “C”.
Repeat steps iv to xxxi to harvest cancer cells.
Spin Gene Amp tubes 2 min at 800 g at 4°C to collect all buffer.
Discard cap and freeze at -80°C.
Do not remove slide from Arcturus System.
Find each field of view in which cells were harvested.
Acquire images after LCM harvest.
Compare before / after LCM images.
Count the number of harvested cells for each population.
Evaluate the degree of contamination from co-harvested cells, if any.
Acquire overview images of the total harvested area.
Perform LCM harvest immediately after IF staining.
Harvest around 50 cells per population or up to 200 cells in cases with abundant target cells.
Select fluorochromes stable during ethanol and xylene dehydration steps.
Use DAPI, AF488, and AF594 for fluorescence stability.
Consider using AF405 conjugated antibody as an alternative nuclear marker.
Pause LCM process; harvested material is stable at -80°C once lysed.
Store lysates in freezer to extract RNA and prepare libraries in batches.
Prepare a stock solution of 10× Reaction Buffer by mixing the 10× Lysis Buffer with the RNase Inhibitor: 19 μL 10× lysis buffer + 1 μL RNase inhibitor = 20 μL total volume.
Transfer 10.5 μL total RNA to a 0.2 mL RNase-free PCR tube.
Add 1 μL of 10× reaction buffer to the tube.
Place samples on ice, add 1 μL 3′SMART-Seq CDS Primer II A (12 μM).
Mix well.
Incubate the tubes at 72°C in a preheated, hot-lid thermal cycler for 3 min.
Prepare master mix per reaction: 4 μL 5× ultra low first-strand buffer, 1 μL SMART-Seq v4 oligonucleotide (48 μM), 0.5 μL RNase inhibitor (40 U/μL), 5.5 μL total volume added per reaction.
Immediately after the 3 min incubation at 72°C, place the samples on ice for 2 min.
Preheat the thermal cycler to 42°C.
Add 2 μL per reaction of the SMARTScribe Reverse Transcriptase to the master mix, add just prior to use.
Add 7.5 μL of the master mix to each reaction tube.
Place the tube in a thermal cycler.
Run the thermal cycler program at 42°C for 90 minutes, then at 70°C for 10 minutes, and finally at 4°C indefinitely.
Thaw PCR reagent on ice.
Prepare PCR master mix by mixing 25 μL of 2× SepAmp PCR buffer, 1 μL of PCR primer II A (12 μM), 1 μL of SepAmp DNA polymerase, and 3 μL of nuclease-free water to a total volume of 30 μL.
Add 30 μL of the prepared PCR master mix to each tube containing 20 μL of first strand cDNA product.
Place the tubes in the thermal cycler.

Run the thermal cycling program at 95°C for 1 minute, followed by cycles of 98°C for 10 seconds, 65°C for 30 seconds, and 68°C for 3 minutes, then a final extension at 72°C for 10 minutes, and finally at 4°C indefinitely.
For fewer than 50 cells, proceed with 18 cycles.
Add 1 μL of 10× lysis buffer to each PCR product tube.
Add 50 μL of AMPure XP beads to each sample.
Mix thoroughly on a vortexer at 1,000 rpm for 8 minutes to allow cDNA binding to the beads.
Apply the mixture to a magnetic separation device and discard the supernatant.
Keep samples on the magnetic separation device.
Add 50 μL of freshly made 80% ethanol to each sample.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, then pipette out the supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more.
Spin down the tubes for 30 seconds and place back on the magnetic device to remove all remaining ethanol.
Place samples at 23°C to dry.
Add 45 μL of elution buffer to each sample to cover the bead pellet.
Incubate at 23°C for 2 minutes to rehydrate.
Place back on the magnetic separation device for 1 minute and collect the supernatant containing purified cDNA.
Determine the amount of purified cDNA.
Store the purified cDNA at -20°C.
Turn the power ON for the Covaris system and the main cooler.
Add about 1.9 L of distilled or deionized water to the water bath.
Check the water level in the cooler and adjust by adding distilled or deionized water if necessary.
Close the door and open the Sonolab software.
Click “ON” for the degassed button and degas the water bath for 30 min.
Transfer approximately 45 μL of Elution Buffer + cDNA mixture into the E220 focused-ultrasonicators AFA 96 microTUBE Plate.
Put the plate into the appropriate location on the sample holder.
For shearing, set the peak power to 450, duty factor to 30, cycles to 200, and time to 220 s.
Prepare fragmented DNA for library preparation with NEBNext DNA library prep master mix set for Illumina.
Add 1× TE to a final volume of 50 μL if the DNA volume post shearing is less than 50 μL.
Alternatively, dilute samples with 10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0 or 0.1× TE if necessary.
Combine 3 μL NEBNext Ultra II end prep enzyme mix and 7 μL NEBNext Ultra II end prep reaction buffer.
Mix the combination with 50 μL fragmented DNA for library preparation.
Incubate in a thermal cycler for 30 minutes at 20°C.
Incubate in a thermal cycler for 30 minutes at 65°C.
Hold at 4°C.
Mix 60 μL end prep reaction mix with the specified components for adaptor ligation.
Dilute NEBNext Adapter to either a 1:10 or 1:25 ratio with water, depending on DNA quantity.
Incubate in a thermal cycler for 15 minutes at 20°C with the heated lid off.
Add 3 μL of (red) USER enzyme mix and incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes with lid set to >47°C.
Clean up with AMPure XP beads if starting material is >50 ng, following size selection protocol.
Clean up with AMPure XP beads without size selection if input ≤ 50 ng to maintain library complexity.
Mix 23 μL adaptor ligated DNA fragments with specified PCR enrichment components.
Place the tubes in a thermal cycler for 98°C for 30 seconds.
Cycle through [98°C for 10 seconds, 65°C for 75 seconds] for 3–15 cycles depending on input DNA fragments.
Incubate at 65°C for 5 minutes.
Hold at 4°C forever.
Clean up with AMPure XP beads after PCR enrichment.
Check the library quality using a gel qualification method (bioanalyzer, high sensitivity DNA kit).
Ensure the electropherogram shows a narrow distribution with a peak size approximately 300 bp.
CallCheck that the electropherogram shows a narrow distribution with a peak size approximately 300 bp.
